Having spent his entire career in the growth and development of the financial sector of Nepal and preservation of Nepal’s heritage, Prithvi Bahadur Pande, Chairperson of Nepal Investment Mega Bank Ltd. (NIMBL), has contributed immensely to elevating Nepal’s banking system to international standards. Pande, who has also been dedicated to promoting Nepal’s heritage, culture, and social development, suddenly fells victim to unlawful government actions and atrocities. He was eventually released on a bail of Rs. 4 million by the district court over his lawful role in securing collateral to safeguard public deposits. The bail is a consolation rather than justice.
